block.zh-Hant: （大衞的詩。）雅偉對我主説：「你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。」
block.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “你们看见那行毁坏可憎的，站在不当站的地方（读这经的人须要会意）。那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀這經的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
ntBlock.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

block.zh-Hans: 一七之内，他必与许多人坚定盟约；一七之半，他必使祭祀与供献止息。那行毁坏可憎的如飞而来，并且有忿怒倾在那行毁坏的身上，直到所定的结局。”
block.zh-Hant: 一七之內，他必與許多人堅定盟約；一七之半，他必使祭祀與供獻止息。那行毀壞可憎的如飛而來，並且有忿怒傾在那行毀壞的身上，直到所定的結局。」
block.en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 众星要从天上坠落，天势都要震动。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
ntBlock.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

block.zh-Hans: 天上的众星群宿，都不发光，日头一出，就变黑暗；月亮也不放光。
block.zh-Hant: 天上的眾星羣宿，都不發光，日頭一出，就變黑暗；月亮也不放光。
block.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

block.zh-Hans: 天上的万象都要消没；天被卷起，好像书卷。其上的万象要残败，像葡萄树的叶子残败，又像无花果树的叶子残败一样。
block.zh-Hant: 天上的萬象都要消沒；天被捲起，好像書卷。其上的萬象要殘敗，像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗，又像無花果樹的葉子殘敗一樣。
block.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

block.zh-Hans: 它们一来，地震天动，日月昏暗，星宿无光。
block.zh-Hant: 它們一來，地震天動，日月昏暗，星宿無光。
block.en: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 那时，他们要看见人子有大能力、大荣耀，驾云降临。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 那時，他們要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
ntBlock.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

block.zh-Hans: 我在夜间的异象中观看，见有一位像人子的，驾着天云而来，被领到亘古常在者面前，
block.zh-Hant: 我在夜間的異象中觀看，見有一位像人子的，駕着天雲而來，被領到亙古常在者面前，
block.en: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣对他们说：“你们都要跌倒了，因为经上记着说：‘我要击打牧人，羊就分散了。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌對他們説：「你們都要跌倒了，因為經上記着説：『我要擊打牧人，羊就分散了。』
ntBlock.en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

block.zh-Hans: 万军之雅伟说：“刀剑哪！应当兴起，攻击我的牧人和我的同伴。击打牧人，羊就分散。我必反手加在微小者的身上。”
block.zh-Hant: 萬軍之雅偉説：「刀劍哪！應當興起，攻擊我的牧人和我的同伴。擊打牧人，羊就分散。我必反手加在微小者的身上。」
block.en: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣说：“我是。你们必看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌説：「我是。你們必看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
ntBlock.en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

block.zh-Hans: （大卫的诗。）雅伟对我主说：“你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。”
block.zh-Hant: （大衞的詩。）雅偉對我主説：「你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。」
block.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

block.zh-Hans: 我在夜间的异象中观看，见有一位像人子的，驾着天云而来，被领到亘古常在者面前，
block.zh-Hant: 我在夜間的異象中觀看，見有一位像人子的，駕着天雲而來，被領到亙古常在者面前，
block.en: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 于是将他钉在十字架上，拈阄分他的衣服，看是谁得什么。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 於是將他釘在十字架上，拈鬮分他的衣服，看是誰得甚麼。
ntBlock.en: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

block.zh-Hans: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。
block.zh-Hant: 他們分我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。
block.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 申初的时候，耶稣大声喊着说：“以罗伊！以罗伊！拉马撒巴各大尼？”翻出来就是：“我的神！我的神！为什么离弃我？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 申初的時候，耶穌大聲喊着説：「以羅伊！以羅伊！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」翻出來就是：「我的神！我的神！為甚麼離棄我？」
ntBlock.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

block.zh-Hans: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用朝鹿。）我的神！我的神！为什么离弃我？为什么远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？
block.zh-Hant: （大衞的詩，交與伶長。調用朝鹿。）我的神！我的神！為甚麼離棄我？為甚麼遠離不救我？不聽我唉哼的言語？
block.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 约瑟也从加利利的拿撒勒城上犹太去，到了大卫的城，名叫伯利恒，因他本是大卫一族一家的人，
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 約瑟也從加利利的拿撒勒城上猶太去，到了大衞的城，名叫伯利恆，因他本是大衞一族一家的人，
ntBlock.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

block.zh-Hans: 你寿数满足、与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位；我也必坚定他的国。他必为我的名建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。你的家和你的国必在我面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。’”
block.zh-Hant: 你壽數滿足、與你列祖同睡的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位；我也必堅定他的國。他必為我的名建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖責打他，用人的鞭責罰他。但我的慈愛仍不離開他，像離開在你面前所廢棄的掃羅一樣。你的家和你的國必在我面前永遠堅立。你的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。』」
block.en:
And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom. 
He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever. 
I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men: 
But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee. 
And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: （正如主[雅伟]的律法上所记：“凡头生的男子必称圣归主[雅伟]；”）
ntBlock.zh-Hant: （正如主[雅偉]的律法上所記：「凡頭生的男子必稱聖歸主[雅偉]；」）
ntBlock.en: (As it is written in the law of the LORD, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

block.zh-Hans: “以色列中凡头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分别为圣归我。”
block.zh-Hant: 「以色列中凡頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分別為聖歸我。」
block.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

block.zh-Hans: 那时你要将一切头生的，并牲畜中头生的，归给雅伟；公的都要属雅伟。
block.zh-Hant: 那時你要將一切頭生的，並牲畜中頭生的，歸給雅偉；公的都要屬雅偉。
block.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD's.

block.zh-Hans: 那时法老几乎不容我们去，雅伟就把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都杀了。因此，我把一切头生的公牲畜献给雅伟为祭，但将头生的儿子都赎出来。
block.zh-Hant: 那時法老幾乎不容我們去，雅偉就把埃及地所有頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都殺了。因此，我把一切頭生的公牲畜獻給雅偉為祭，但將頭生的兒子都贖出來。
block.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 又要照主[雅伟]的律法上所说，“或用一对斑鸠，或用两只雏鸽”献祭。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 又要照主[雅偉]的律法上所説，「或用一對斑鳩，或用兩隻雛鴿」獻祭。
ntBlock.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

block.zh-Hans: “他的力量若不够献两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，就要因所犯的罪带供物来，就是细面伊法十分之一为赎罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因为是赎罪祭。
block.zh-Hant: 「他的力量若不夠獻兩隻斑鳩，或是兩隻雛鴿，就要因所犯的罪帶供物來，就是細麵伊法十分之一為贖罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因為是贖罪祭。
block.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

block.zh-Hans: 她的力量若不够献一只羊羔，她就要取两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，一只为燔祭，一只为赎罪祭。祭司要为她赎罪，她就洁净了。”
block.zh-Hant: 她的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，她就要取兩隻斑鳩，或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻為燔祭，一隻為贖罪祭。祭司要為她贖罪，她就潔淨了。」
block.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 凡有血气的，都要见神的救恩’！”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 凡有血氣的，都要見神的救恩』！」
ntBlock.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

block.zh-Hans: 有人声喊着说：“在旷野预备雅伟的路，在沙漠地修平我们神的道。一切山洼都要填满，大小山冈都要削平；高高低低的要改为平坦，崎崎岖岖的必成为平原。雅伟的荣耀必然显现；凡有血气的必一同看见；因为这是雅伟亲口说的。”
block.zh-Hant: 有人聲喊着説：「在曠野預備雅偉的路，在沙漠地修平我們神的道。一切山窪都要填滿，大小山岡都要削平；高高低低的要改為平坦，崎崎嶇嶇的必成為平原。雅偉的榮耀必然顯現；凡有血氣的必一同看見；因為這是雅偉親口説的。」
block.en:
The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God. 
Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain: 
And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 圣灵降临在他身上，形状仿佛鸽子；又有声音从天上来，说：“你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 聖靈降臨在他身上，形狀彷彿鴿子；又有聲音從天上來，説：「你是我的愛子，我喜悦你。」
ntBlock.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

block.zh-Hans: 受膏者说：“我要传圣旨。雅伟曾对我说：‘你是我的儿子，我今日生你。
block.zh-Hant: 受膏者説：「我要傳聖旨。雅偉曾對我説：『你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
block.en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

block.zh-Hans: “看哪！我的仆人，我所扶持所拣选、心里所喜悦的！我已将我的灵赐给他；他必将公理传给外邦。
block.zh-Hant: 「看哪！我的僕人，我所扶持所揀選、心裏所喜悦的！我已將我的靈賜給他；他必將公理傳給外邦。
block.en: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

block.zh-Hans: 惟你以色列我的仆人，雅各我所拣选的，我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔，
block.zh-Hant: 惟你以色列我的僕人，雅各我所揀選的，我朋友亞伯拉罕的後裔，
block.en: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

block.zh-Hans: 天使说：“你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。”
block.zh-Hant: 天使説：「你不可在這童子身上下手。一點不可害他！現在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因為你沒有將你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，留下不給我。」
block.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

block.zh-Hans: “雅伟说：‘你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指着自己起誓说：
block.zh-Hant: 「雅偉説：『你既行了這事，不留下你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，我便指着自己起誓説：
block.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣回答说：“经上记着说：‘人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠神口里所出的一切话。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌回答説：「經上記着説：『人活着不是單靠食物，乃是靠神口裏所出的一切話。』」
ntBlock.en: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

block.zh-Hans: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠雅伟口里所出的一切话。
block.zh-Hant: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活着不是單靠食物，乃是靠雅偉口裏所出的一切話。
block.en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣说：“经上记着说：‘当拜主[雅伟]你的神，单要事奉他。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌説：「經上記着説：『當拜主[雅偉]你的神，單要事奉他。』」
ntBlock.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

block.zh-Hans: 你要敬畏雅伟你的神，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
block.zh-Hant: 你要敬畏雅偉你的神，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
block.en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 因为经上记着说：‘主要为你吩咐他的使者保护你；
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 因為經上記着説：『主要為你吩咐他的使者保護你；
ntBlock.en: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

block.zh-Hans: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保护你。
block.zh-Hant: 因他要為你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保護你。
block.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他們要用手托着你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。』」
ntBlock.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

block.zh-Hans: 他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。
block.zh-Hant: 他們要用手托着你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
block.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣对他说：“经上说：‘不可试探主[雅伟]你的神。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌對他説：「經上説：『不可試探主[雅偉]你的神。』」
ntBlock.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

block.zh-Hans: “你们不可试探雅伟你们的神，像你们在玛撒那样试探他。
block.zh-Hant: 「你們不可試探雅偉你們的神，像你們在瑪撒那樣試探他。
block.en: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 报告神悦纳人的禧年。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 報告神悦納人的禧年。」
ntBlock.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

block.zh-Hans: 主雅伟的灵在我身上；因为雅伟用膏膏我，叫我传好信息给谦卑的人，差遣我医好伤心的人，报告被掳的得释放，被囚的出监牢；报告雅伟的恩年，和我们神报仇的日子；安慰一切悲哀的人，
block.zh-Hant: 主雅偉的靈在我身上；因為雅偉用膏膏我，叫我傳好信息給謙卑的人，差遣我醫好傷心的人，報告被擄的得釋放，被囚的出監牢；報告雅偉的恩年，和我們神報仇的日子；安慰一切悲哀的人，
block.en:
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound; 
To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

block.zh-Hans: 我所拣选的禁食不是要松开凶恶的绳，解下轭上的索，使被欺压的得自由，折断一切的轭吗？
block.zh-Hant: 我所揀選的禁食不是要鬆開兇惡的繩，解下軛上的索，使被欺壓的得自由，折斷一切的軛嗎？
block.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 经上记着说：‘我要差遣我的使者在你前面预备道路，’所说的就是这个人。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 經上記着説：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路，』所説的就是這個人。
ntBlock.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

block.zh-Hans: 万军之雅伟说：“我要差遣我的使者在我前面预备道路。你们所寻求的主，必忽然进入他的殿；立约的使者，就是你们所仰慕的，快要来到。”
block.zh-Hant: 萬軍之雅偉説：「我要差遣我的使者在我前面預備道路。你們所尋求的主，必忽然進入他的殿；立約的使者，就是你們所仰慕的，快要來到。」
block.en: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the LORD, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.

block.zh-Hans: “看哪！我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保护你，领你到我所预备的地方去。
block.zh-Hant: 「看哪！我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保護你，領你到我所預備的地方去。
block.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他说：“神国的奥秘只叫你们知道；至于别人，就用比喻，叫‘他们看也看不见，听也听不明。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他説：「神國的奧秘只叫你們知道；至於別人，就用比喻，叫『他們看也看不見，聽也聽不明。』
ntBlock.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

block.zh-Hans: 他说：“你去告诉这百姓说：‘你们听是要听见，却不明白；看是要看见，却不晓得。
block.zh-Hant: 他説：「你去告訴這百姓説：『你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得。
block.en: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他的门徒雅各、约翰看见了，就说：“主[耶稣]啊，你要我们吩咐火从天上降下来烧灭他们，像以利亚所作的吗？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他的門徒雅各、約翰看見了，就説：「主[耶穌]啊，你要我們吩咐火從天上降下來燒滅他們，像以利亞所作的嗎？」
ntBlock.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

block.zh-Hans: 以利亚回答说：“我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人。”于是有火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
block.zh-Hant: 以利亞回答説：「我若是神人，願火從天上降下來，燒滅你和你那五十人。」於是有火從天上降下來，燒滅五十夫長和他那五十人。
block.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

block.zh-Hans: 以利亚回答说：“我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人。”于是神的火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
block.zh-Hant: 以利亞回答説：「我若是神人，願火從天上降下來，燒滅你和你那五十人。」於是神的火從天上降下來，燒滅五十夫長和他那五十人。
block.en: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

block.zh-Hans: 已经有火从天上降下来，烧灭前两次来的五十夫长和他们各自带的五十人；现在愿我的性命在你眼前看为宝贵。”
block.zh-Hant: 已經有火從天上降下來，燒滅前兩次來的五十夫長和他們各自帶的五十人；現在願我的性命在你眼前看為寶貴。」
block.en: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣对他们说：“我曾看见撒但从天上坠落，像闪电一样。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌對他們説：「我曾看見撒但從天上墜落，像閃電一樣。
ntBlock.en: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

block.zh-Hans: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊，你何竟从天坠落？你这攻败列国的，何竟被砍倒在地上？
block.zh-Hant: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊，你何竟從天墜落？你這攻敗列國的，何竟被砍倒在地上？
block.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他回答说：“你要尽心、尽性、尽力、尽意爱主[雅伟]你的神；又要爱邻舍如同自己。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他回答説：「你要盡心、盡性、盡力、盡意愛主[雅偉]你的神；又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」
ntBlock.en: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

block.zh-Hans: 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱雅伟你的神。
block.zh-Hant: 你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛雅偉你的神。
block.en: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

block.zh-Hans: 不可报仇，也不可埋怨你本国的子民，却要爱人如己。我是雅伟。
block.zh-Hant: 不可報仇，也不可埋怨你本國的子民，卻要愛人如己。我是雅偉。
block.en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am the LORD.

block.zh-Hans: “以色列啊，你要听！雅伟我们神是独一的主。你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱雅伟你的神。
block.zh-Hant: 「以色列啊，你要聽！雅偉我們神是獨一的主。你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛雅偉你的神。
block.en:
Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: 
And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，从今以后你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：‘奉主[雅伟]名来的是应当称颂的。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。我告訴你們，從今以後你們不得再見我，直等到你們説：『奉主[雅偉]名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
ntBlock.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

block.zh-Hans: 奉雅伟名来的，是应当称颂的；我们从雅伟的殿中，为你们祝福。
block.zh-Hant: 奉雅偉名來的，是應當稱頌的；我們從雅偉的殿中，為你們祝福。
block.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 你们要回想罗得的妻子。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 你們要回想羅得的妻子。
ntBlock.en: Remember Lot's wife.

block.zh-Hans: 罗得的妻子在后边回头一看，就变成了一根盐柱。
block.zh-Hant: 羅得的妻子在後邊回頭一看，就變成了一根鹽柱。
block.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 诫命你是晓得的：‘不可奸淫；不可杀人；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；当孝敬父母。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 誡命你是曉得的：『不可姦淫；不可殺人；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；當孝敬父母。』」
ntBlock.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

block.zh-Hans: “当孝敬父母，使你的日子在雅伟你神所赐你的地上得以长久。“不可杀人。“不可奸淫。“不可偷盗。“不可作假见证陷害人。
block.zh-Hant: 「當孝敬父母，使你的日子在雅偉你神所賜你的地上得以長久。「不可殺人。「不可姦淫。「不可偷盜。「不可作假見證陷害人。
block.en:
Honor thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee. 
Thou shalt not kill. 
Thou shalt not commit adultery. 
Thou shalt not steal. 
Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.

block.zh-Hans: “‘当照雅伟你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，并使你的日子在雅伟你神所赐你的地上得以长久。“‘不可杀人。“‘不可奸淫。“‘不可偷盗。“‘不可作假见证陷害人。
block.zh-Hant: 「『當照雅偉你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，並使你的日子在雅偉你神所賜你的地上得以長久。「『不可殺人。「『不可姦淫。「『不可偷盜。「『不可作假見證陷害人。
block.en:
Honor thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee. 
Thou shalt not kill. 
Neither shalt thou commit adultery. 
Neither shalt thou steal. 
Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbor.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 说：“奉主[雅伟]名来的王是应当称颂的！在天上有和平；在至高之处有荣光。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 説：「奉主[雅偉]名來的王是應當稱頌的！在天上有和平；在至高之處有榮光。」
ntBlock.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

block.zh-Hans: 奉雅伟名来的，是应当称颂的；我们从雅伟的殿中，为你们祝福。
block.zh-Hant: 奉雅偉名來的，是應當稱頌的；我們從雅偉的殿中，為你們祝福。
block.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 对他们说：“经上说：‘我的殿必作祷告的殿’，你们倒使它成为贼窝了。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 對他們説：「經上説：『我的殿必作禱告的殿』，你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
ntBlock.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

block.zh-Hans: 我必领他们到我的圣山，使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。他们的燔祭和平安祭，在我坛上必蒙悦纳，因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。”
block.zh-Hant: 我必領他們到我的聖山，使他們在禱告我的殿中喜樂。他們的燔祭和平安祭，在我壇上必蒙悦納，因我的殿必稱為萬民禱告的殿。」
block.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

block.zh-Hans: 这称为我名下的殿，在你们眼中，岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是雅伟说的。
block.zh-Hant: 這稱為我名下的殿，在你們眼中，豈可看為賊窩嗎？我都看見了。這是雅偉説的。
block.en: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣看着他们说：“经上记着：‘匠人所弃的石头已作了房角的头块石头。’这是什么意思呢？
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌看着他們説：「經上記着：『匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。』這是甚麼意思呢？
ntBlock.en: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

block.zh-Hans: 匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头。这是雅伟所做的，在我们眼中看为希奇。
block.zh-Hant: 匠人所棄的石頭，已成了房角的頭塊石頭。這是雅偉所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。
block.en:
The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner. 
This is the LORD's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

block.zh-Hans: 匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头。
block.zh-Hant: 匠人所棄的石頭，已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
block.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “夫子！摩西为我们写着说：人若有妻无子就死了，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「夫子！摩西為我們寫着説：人若有妻無子就死了，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。
ntBlock.en: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

block.zh-Hans: “弟兄同居，若死了一个，没有儿子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟当尽弟兄的本分，娶她为妻，与她同房。
block.zh-Hant: 「弟兄同居，若死了一個，沒有兒子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟當盡弟兄的本分，娶她為妻，與她同房。
block.en: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 至于死人复活，摩西在荆棘篇上，称主[雅伟]是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，就指示明白了。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 至於死人復活，摩西在荊棘篇上，稱主[雅偉]是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，就指示明白了。
ntBlock.en: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

block.zh-Hans: 又说：“我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。”摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看神。
block.zh-Hant: 又説：「我是你父親的神，是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。」摩西蒙上臉，因為怕看神。
block.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。』
ntBlock.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

block.zh-Hans: （大卫的诗。）雅伟对我主说：“你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。”
block.zh-Hant: （大衞的詩。）雅偉對我主説：「你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。」
block.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 天势都要震动，人想起那将要临到世界的事，就都吓得魂不附体。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 天勢都要震動，人想起那將要臨到世界的事，就都嚇得魂不附體。
ntBlock.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

block.zh-Hans: 天上的万象都要消没；天被卷起，好像书卷。其上的万象要残败，像葡萄树的叶子残败，又像无花果树的叶子残败一样。
block.zh-Hant: 天上的萬象都要消沒；天被捲起，好像書卷。其上的萬象要殘敗，像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗，又像無花果樹的葉子殘敗一樣。
block.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 那时，他们要看见人子有能力，有大荣耀驾云降临。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 那時，他們要看見人子有能力，有大榮耀駕雲降臨。
ntBlock.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

block.zh-Hans: 我在夜间的异象中观看，见有一位像人子的，驾着天云而来，被领到亘古常在者面前，
block.zh-Hant: 我在夜間的異象中觀看，見有一位像人子的，駕着天雲而來，被領到亙古常在者面前，
block.en: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 我告诉你们，经上写着说：‘他被列在罪犯之中’。这话必应验在我身上；因为那关系我的事必然成就。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 我告訴你們，經上寫着説：『他被列在罪犯之中』。這話必應驗在我身上；因為那關係我的事必然成就。」
ntBlock.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

block.zh-Hans: 所以，我要使他与位大的同分，与强盛的均分掳物。因为他将命倾倒，以致于死；他也被列在罪犯之中。他却担当多人的罪，又为罪犯代求。
block.zh-Hant: 所以，我要使他與位大的同分，與強盛的均分擄物。因為他將命傾倒，以致於死；他也被列在罪犯之中。他卻擔當多人的罪，又為罪犯代求。
block.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 从今以后，人子要坐在神权能的右边。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 從今以後，人子要坐在神權能的右邊。」
ntBlock.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

block.zh-Hans: （大卫的诗。）雅伟对我主说：“你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。”
block.zh-Hant: （大衞的詩。）雅偉對我主説：「你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。」
block.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 那时，人要向大山说：‘倒在我们身上！’向小山说：‘遮盖我们！’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 那時，人要向大山説：『倒在我們身上！』向小山説：『遮蓋我們！』
ntBlock.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

block.zh-Hans: 伯亚文的邱坛，就是以色列取罪的地方必被毁灭；荆棘和蒺藜必长在他们的祭坛上。他们必对大山说：“遮盖我们！”对小山说：“倒在我们身上！”
block.zh-Hant: 伯亞文的邱壇，就是以色列取罪的地方必被毀滅；荊棘和蒺藜必長在他們的祭壇上。他們必對大山説：「遮蓋我們！」對小山説：「倒在我們身上！」
block.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 当下耶稣说：“父啊！赦免他们；因为他们所做的，他们不晓得。”兵丁就拈阄分他的衣服。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 當下耶穌説：「父啊！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。」兵丁就拈鬮分他的衣服。
ntBlock.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

block.zh-Hans: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。
block.zh-Hant: 他們分我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。
block.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣大声喊着说：“父啊！我将我的灵魂交在你手里。”说了这话，气就断了。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌大聲喊着説：「父啊！我將我的靈魂交在你手裏。」説了這話，氣就斷了。
ntBlock.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

block.zh-Hans: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里；雅伟诚实的神啊！你救赎了我。
block.zh-Hant: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裏；雅偉誠實的神啊！你救贖了我。
block.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 生命在他里头，这生命就是人的光。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 生命在他裏頭，這生命就是人的光。
ntBlock.en: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

block.zh-Hans: 因为在你那里有生命的源头；在你的光中，我们必得见光。
block.zh-Hant: 因為在你那裏有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。
block.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他说：“我就是那在旷野有人声喊着说：‘修直主[雅伟]的道路；’正如先知以赛亚所说的。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他説：「我就是那在曠野有人聲喊着説：『修直主[雅偉]的道路；』正如先知以賽亞所説的。」
ntBlock.en: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

block.zh-Hans: 有人声喊着说：“在旷野预备雅伟的路，在沙漠地修平我们神的道。
block.zh-Hant: 有人聲喊着説：「在曠野預備雅偉的路，在沙漠地修平我們神的道。
block.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣看见拿但业来，就指着他说：“看哪，这是个真以色列人，他心里是没有诡诈的。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌看見拿但業來，就指着他説：「看哪，這是個真以色列人，他心裏是沒有詭詐的。」
ntBlock.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

block.zh-Hans: 凡心里没有诡诈、雅伟不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。
block.zh-Hant: 凡心裏沒有詭詐、雅偉不算為有罪的，這人是有福的。
block.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 拿但业说：“拉比，你是神的儿子，你是以色列的王！”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 拿但業説：「拉比，你是神的兒子，你是以色列的王！」
ntBlock.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

block.zh-Hans: 说：“我已经立我的君在锡安我的圣山上了。”受膏者说：“我要传圣旨。雅伟曾对我说：‘你是我的儿子，我今日生你。
block.zh-Hant: 説：「我已經立我的君在錫安我的聖山上了。」受膏者説：「我要傳聖旨。雅偉曾對我説：『你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
block.en:
Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion. 
I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 看见殿里有卖牛、羊、鸽子的，并有兑换银钱的人坐在那里，
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 看見殿裏有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，並有兑換銀錢的人坐在那裏，
ntBlock.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

block.zh-Hans: 我必领他们到我的圣山，使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。他们的燔祭和平安祭，在我坛上必蒙悦纳，因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。”
block.zh-Hant: 我必領他們到我的聖山，使他們在禱告我的殿中喜樂。他們的燔祭和平安祭，在我壇上必蒙悦納，因我的殿必稱為萬民禱告的殿。」
block.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

block.zh-Hans: 这称为我名下的殿，在你们眼中，岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是雅伟说的。
block.zh-Hant: 這稱為我名下的殿，在你們眼中，豈可看為賊窩嗎？我都看見了。這是雅偉説的。
block.en: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.

block.zh-Hans: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧，并且辱骂你人的辱骂，都落在我身上。
block.zh-Hant: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒，並且辱罵你人的辱罵，都落在我身上。
block.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 又对卖鸽子的说：“把这些东西拿去！不要将我父的殿当作买卖的地方。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 又對賣鴿子的説：「把這些東西拿去！不要將我父的殿當作買賣的地方。」
ntBlock.en: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

block.zh-Hans: 当那日，马的铃铛上，必有“归雅伟为圣”的这句话。雅伟殿内的锅，必如祭坛前的碗一样。凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅，都必归万军之雅伟为圣。凡献祭的，都必来取这锅，煮肉在其中。当那日，在万军之雅伟的殿中，必不再有迦南人。
block.zh-Hant: 當那日，馬的鈴鐺上，必有「歸雅偉為聖」的這句話。雅偉殿內的鍋，必如祭壇前的碗一樣。凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋，都必歸萬軍之雅偉為聖。凡獻祭的，都必來取這鍋，煮肉在其中。當那日，在萬軍之雅偉的殿中，必不再有迦南人。
block.en:
In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowls before the altar. 
Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他的门徒就想起经上记着说：“我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他的門徒就想起經上記着説：「我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒。」
ntBlock.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

block.zh-Hans: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧，并且辱骂你人的辱骂，都落在我身上。
block.zh-Hant: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒，並且辱罵你人的辱罵，都落在我身上。
block.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 摩西在旷野怎样举蛇，人子也必照样被举起来，
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，
ntBlock.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

block.zh-Hans: 就怨讟神和摩西说：“你们为什么把我们从埃及领出来、使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮，没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。”于是雅伟使火蛇进入百姓中间，蛇就咬他们。以色列人中死了许多。百姓到摩西那里，说：“我们怨讟雅伟和你，有罪了。求你祷告雅伟，叫这些蛇离开我们。”于是摩西为百姓祷告。雅伟对摩西说：“你制造一条火蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望这蛇，就必得活。”摩西便制造一条铜蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望这铜蛇，就活了。
block.zh-Hant: 就怨讟神和摩西説：「你們為甚麼把我們從埃及領出來、使我們死在曠野呢？這裏沒有糧，沒有水，我們的心厭惡這淡薄的食物。」於是雅偉使火蛇進入百姓中間，蛇就咬他們。以色列人中死了許多。百姓到摩西那裏，説：「我們怨讟雅偉和你，有罪了。求你禱告雅偉，叫這些蛇離開我們。」於是摩西為百姓禱告。雅偉對摩西説：「你製造一條火蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望這蛇，就必得活。」摩西便製造一條銅蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望這銅蛇，就活了。
block.en:
And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread. 
And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died. 
Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people. 
And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live. 
And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说：“这真是那要到世间来的先知！”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就説：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」
ntBlock.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟你的神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知像我，你们要听从他。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉你的神要從你們弟兄中間給你興起一位先知像我，你們要聽從他。
block.en: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如经上写着说：‘他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如經上寫着説：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」
ntBlock.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

block.zh-Hans: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃，将天上的粮食赐给他们。
block.zh-Hant: 降嗎哪，像雨給他們吃，將天上的糧食賜給他們。
block.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟对摩西说：“我要将粮食从天降给你们。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好试验他们遵不遵我的法度。到第六天，他们要把所收进来的预备好了，比每天所收的多一倍。”摩西、亚伦对以色列众人说：“到了晚上，你们要知道是雅伟将你们从埃及地领出来的。早晨，你们要看见雅伟的荣耀，因为雅伟听见你们向他所发的怨言了。我们算什么，你们竟向我们发怨言呢？”摩西又说：“雅伟晚上必给你们肉吃，早晨必给你们食物得饱；因为你们向雅伟发的怨言，他都听见了。我们算什么，你们的怨言不是向我们发的，乃是向雅伟发的。”摩西对亚伦说：“你告诉以色列全会众说：‘你们就近雅伟面前，因为他已经听见你们的怨言了。’”亚伦正对以色列全会众说话的时候，他们向旷野观看，不料，雅伟的荣光在云中显现。雅伟晓谕摩西说：“我已经听见以色列人的怨言。你告诉他们说：‘到黄昏的时候，你们要吃肉，早晨必有食物得饱，你们就知道我是雅伟你们的神。’”到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞来，遮满了营；早晨在营四围的地上有露水。露水上升之后，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圆物。以色列人看见，不知道是什么，就彼此对问说：“这是什么呢？”摩西对他们说：“这就是雅伟给你们吃的食物。雅伟所吩咐的是这样：你们要按着各人的饭量，为帐棚里的人，按着人数收起来，各拿一俄梅珥。”以色列人就这样行；有多收的，有少收的。及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也没有余，少收的也没有缺；各人按着自己的饭量收取。摩西对他们说：“所收的，不许什么人留到早晨。”然而他们不听摩西的话，内中有留到早晨的，就生虫变臭了；摩西便向他们发怒。他们每日早晨，按着各人的饭量收取，日头一发热，就消化了。到第六天，他们收了双倍的食物，每人两俄梅珥。会众的官长来告诉摩西；摩西对他们说：“雅伟这样说：‘明天是圣安息日，是向雅伟守的圣安息日。你们要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。’”他们就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，里头也没有虫子。摩西说：“你们今天吃这个吧！因为今天是向雅伟守的安息日；你们在田野必找不着了。六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必没有了。”第七天，百姓中有人出去收，什么也找不着。雅伟对摩西说：“你们不肯守我的诫命和律法，要到几时呢？你们看！雅伟既将安息日赐给你们，所以第六天他赐给你们两天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不许什么人出去。”于是百姓第七天安息了。这食物，以色列家叫吗哪；样子像芫荽子，颜色是白的，滋味如同搀蜜的薄饼。摩西说：“雅伟所吩咐的是这样：‘要将一满俄梅珥吗哪留到世世代代，使后人可以看见我当日将你们领出埃及地，在旷野所给你们吃的食物。’”摩西对亚伦说：“你拿一个罐子，盛一满俄梅珥吗哪，存在雅伟面前，要留到世世代代。”雅伟怎么吩咐摩西，亚伦就怎么行，把吗哪放在法柜前存留。以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。（俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉對摩西説：「我要將糧食從天降給你們。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好試驗他們遵不遵我的法度。到第六天，他們要把所收進來的預備好了，比每天所收的多一倍。」摩西、亞倫對以色列眾人説：「到了晚上，你們要知道是雅偉將你們從埃及地領出來的。早晨，你們要看見雅偉的榮耀，因為雅偉聽見你們向他所發的怨言了。我們算甚麼，你們竟向我們發怨言呢？」摩西又説：「雅偉晚上必給你們肉吃，早晨必給你們食物得飽；因為你們向雅偉發的怨言，他都聽見了。我們算甚麼，你們的怨言不是向我們發的，乃是向雅偉發的。」摩西對亞倫説：「你告訴以色列全會眾説：『你們就近雅偉面前，因為他已經聽見你們的怨言了。』」亞倫正對以色列全會眾説話的時候，他們向曠野觀看，不料，雅偉的榮光在雲中顯現。雅偉曉諭摩西説：「我已經聽見以色列人的怨言。你告訴他們説：『到黃昏的時候，你們要吃肉，早晨必有食物得飽，你們就知道我是雅偉你們的神。』」到了晚上，有鵪鶉飛來，遮滿了營；早晨在營四圍的地上有露水。露水上升之後，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圓物。以色列人看見，不知道是甚麼，就彼此對問説：「這是甚麼呢？」摩西對他們説：「這就是雅偉給你們吃的食物。雅偉所吩咐的是這樣：你們要按着各人的飯量，為帳棚裏的人，按着人數收起來，各拿一俄梅珥。」以色列人就這樣行；有多收的，有少收的。及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也沒有餘，少收的也沒有缺；各人按着自己的飯量收取。摩西對他們説：「所收的，不許甚麼人留到早晨。」然而他們不聽摩西的話，內中有留到早晨的，就生蟲變臭了；摩西便向他們發怒。他們每日早晨，按着各人的飯量收取，日頭一發熱，就消化了。到第六天，他們收了雙倍的食物，每人兩俄梅珥。會眾的官長來告訴摩西；摩西對他們説：「雅偉這樣説：『明天是聖安息日，是向雅偉守的聖安息日。你們要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。』」他們就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，裏頭也沒有蟲子。摩西説：「你們今天吃這個吧！因為今天是向雅偉守的安息日；你們在田野必找不着了。六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必沒有了。」第七天，百姓中有人出去收，甚麼也找不着。雅偉對摩西説：「你們不肯守我的誡命和律法，要到幾時呢？你們看！雅偉既將安息日賜給你們，所以第六天他賜給你們兩天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不許甚麼人出去。」於是百姓第七天安息了。這食物，以色列家叫嗎哪；樣子像芫荽子，顏色是白的，滋味如同攙蜜的薄餅。摩西説：「雅偉所吩咐的是這樣：『要將一滿俄梅珥嗎哪留到世世代代，使後人可以看見我當日將你們領出埃及地，在曠野所給你們吃的食物。』」摩西對亞倫説：「你拿一個罐子，盛一滿俄梅珥嗎哪，存在雅偉面前，要留到世世代代。」雅偉怎麼吩咐摩西，亞倫就怎麼行，把嗎哪放在法櫃前存留。以色列人吃嗎哪共四十年，直到進了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。（俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）
block.en:
Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no. 
And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily. 
And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt: 
And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us? 
And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD. 
And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings. 
And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud. 
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 
I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God. 
And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host. 
And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground. 
And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat. 
This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents. 
And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less. 
And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating. 
And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning. 
Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them. 
And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted. 
And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses. 
And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning. 
And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein. 
And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field. 
Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none. 
And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none. 
And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws? 
See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day. 
So the people rested on the seventh day. 
And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey. 
And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt. 
And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations. 
As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept. 
And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan. 
Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 在先知书上写着说：‘他们都要蒙神的教训。’凡听见父之教训又学习的，就到我这里来。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 在先知書上寫着説：『他們都要蒙神的教訓。』凡聽見父之教訓又學習的，就到我這裏來。
ntBlock.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

block.zh-Hans: 你的儿女都要受雅伟的教训；你的儿女必大享平安。
block.zh-Hant: 你的兒女都要受雅偉的教訓；你的兒女必大享平安。
block.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 信我的人就如经上所说：‘从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 信我的人就如經上所説：『從他腹中要流出活水的江河來。』」
ntBlock.en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

block.zh-Hans: 因为我要将水浇灌口渴的人，将河浇灌干旱之地。我要将我的灵浇灌你的后裔，将我的福浇灌你的子孙。
block.zh-Hant: 因為我要將水澆灌口渴的人，將河澆灌乾旱之地。我要將我的靈澆灌你的後裔，將我的福澆灌你的子孫。
block.en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

block.zh-Hans: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来，没有银钱的也可以来。你们都来，买了吃；不用银钱，不用价值，也来买酒和奶。
block.zh-Hant: 你們一切乾渴的都當就近水來，沒有銀錢的也可以來。你們都來，買了吃；不用銀錢，不用價值，也來買酒和奶。
block.en: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟也必时常引导你，在干旱之地使你心满意足，骨头强壮。你必像浇灌的园子，又像水流不绝的泉源。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉也必時常引導你，在乾旱之地使你心滿意足，骨頭強壯。你必像澆灌的園子，又像水流不絕的泉源。
block.en: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

block.zh-Hans: 那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷出来，一半往东海流，一半往西海流。冬夏都是如此。
block.zh-Hant: 那日，必有活水從耶路撒冷出來，一半往東海流，一半往西海流。冬夏都是如此。
block.en: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 经上岂不是说‘基督是大卫的后裔，从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的’吗？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 經上豈不是説『基督是大衞的後裔，從大衞本鄉伯利恆出來的』嗎？」
ntBlock.en: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

block.zh-Hans: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远；要建立你的宝座，直到万代。”（细拉）
block.zh-Hant: 我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠；要建立你的寶座，直到萬代。」（細拉）
block.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

block.zh-Hans: 伯利恒、以法他啊！你在犹大诸城中为小，将来必有一位从你那里出来，在以色列中为我作掌权的；他的根源从亘古，从太初就有。
block.zh-Hant: 伯利恆、以法他啊！你在猶大諸城中為小，將來必有一位從你那裏出來，在以色列中為我作掌權的；他的根源從亙古，從太初就有。
block.en: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死。你说该把她怎么样呢？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你説該把她怎麼樣呢？」
ntBlock.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

block.zh-Hans: “与邻舍之妻行淫的，奸夫淫妇都必治死。
block.zh-Hant: 「與鄰舍之妻行淫的，姦夫淫婦都必治死。
block.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

block.zh-Hans: “若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。“若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见她，与她行淫，你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死。女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
block.zh-Hant: 「若遇見人與有丈夫的婦人行淫，就要將姦夫淫婦一併治死。這樣，就把那惡從以色列中除掉。「若有處女已經許配丈夫，有人在城裏遇見她，與她行淫，你們就要把這二人帶到本城門，用石頭打死。女子是因為雖在城裏卻沒有喊叫；男子是因為玷污別人的妻。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 你们的律法上也记着说：‘两个人的见证是真的。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 你們的律法上也記着説：『兩個人的見證是真的。』
ntBlock.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

block.zh-Hans: 要凭两三个人的口作见证将那当死的人治死；不可凭一个人的口作见证将他治死。
block.zh-Hant: 要憑兩三個人的口作見證將那當死的人治死；不可憑一個人的口作見證將他治死。
block.en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 门徒问耶稣说：“拉比，这人生来是瞎眼的，是谁犯了罪？是这人呢？是他父母呢？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 門徒問耶穌説：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
ntBlock.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

block.zh-Hans: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也不担当儿子的罪孽。义人的善果必归自己，恶人的恶报也必归自己。
block.zh-Hant: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。兒子必不擔當父親的罪孽，父親也不擔當兒子的罪孽。義人的善果必歸自己，惡人的惡報也必歸自己。
block.en: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

block.zh-Hans: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回，也必不叫我的信实废弃。
block.zh-Hant: 只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回，也必不叫我的信實廢棄。
block.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣说：“你们的律法上岂不是写着，‘我曾说你们是神’吗？
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌説：「你們的律法上豈不是寫着，『我曾説你們是神』嗎？
ntBlock.en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

block.zh-Hans: 我曾说：“你们是神，都是至高者的儿子。
block.zh-Hant: 我曾説：「你們是神，都是至高者的兒子。
block.en: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 就拿着棕树枝出去迎接他，喊着说：“和散那！奉主[雅伟]名来的以色列王是应当称颂的！”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 就拿着棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊着説：「和散那！奉主[雅偉]名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！」
ntBlock.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟啊！求你拯救；雅伟啊！求你使我们亨通。奉雅伟名来的，是应当称颂的；我们从雅伟的殿中，为你们祝福。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉啊！求你拯救；雅偉啊！求你使我們亨通。奉雅偉名來的，是應當稱頌的；我們從雅偉的殿中，為你們祝福。
block.en:
Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity. 
Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣得了一个驴驹，就骑上，如经上所记的说：
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如經上所記的説：
ntBlock.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

block.zh-Hans: 锡安的民哪！应当大大喜乐；耶路撒冷的民哪！应当欢呼。看哪！你的王来到你这里！他是公义的，并且施行拯救，谦谦和和地骑着驴，就是骑着驴的驹子。
block.zh-Hant: 錫安的民哪！應當大大喜樂；耶路撒冷的民哪！應當歡呼。看哪！你的王來到你這裏！他是公義的，並且施行拯救，謙謙和和地騎着驢，就是騎着驢的駒子。
block.en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “锡安的民哪，不要惧怕！你的王骑着驴驹来了。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「錫安的民哪，不要懼怕！你的王騎着驢駒來了。」
ntBlock.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

block.zh-Hans: 锡安的民哪！应当大大喜乐；耶路撒冷的民哪！应当欢呼。看哪！你的王来到你这里！他是公义的，并且施行拯救，谦谦和和地骑着驴，就是骑着驴的驹子。
block.zh-Hant: 錫安的民哪！應當大大喜樂；耶路撒冷的民哪！應當歡呼。看哪！你的王來到你這裏！他是公義的，並且施行拯救，謙謙和和地騎着驢，就是騎着驢的駒子。
block.en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这些事门徒起先不明白，等到耶稣得了荣耀以后才想起这话是指着他写的，并且众人果然向他这样行了。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指着他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。
ntBlock.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

block.zh-Hans: 凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅，都必归万军之雅伟为圣。凡献祭的，都必来取这锅，煮肉在其中。当那日，在万军之雅伟的殿中，必不再有迦南人。
block.zh-Hant: 凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋，都必歸萬軍之雅偉為聖。凡獻祭的，都必來取這鍋，煮肉在其中。當那日，在萬軍之雅偉的殿中，必不再有迦南人。
block.en: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 众人回答说：“我们听见律法上有话说，基督是永存的，你怎么说人子必须被举起来呢？这人子是谁呢？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 眾人回答説：「我們聽見律法上有話説，基督是永存的，你怎麼説人子必須被舉起來呢？這人子是誰呢？」
ntBlock.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

block.zh-Hans: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓：我决不向大卫说谎。他的后裔要存到永远；他的宝座在我面前，如日之恒一般，又如月亮永远坚立，如天上确实的见证。”（细拉）
block.zh-Hant: 我一次指着自己的聖潔起誓：我決不向大衞説謊。他的後裔要存到永遠；他的寶座在我面前，如日之恆一般，又如月亮永遠堅立，如天上確實的見證。」（細拉）
block.en:
Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David. 
His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me. 
It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：“主[雅伟]啊！我们所传的有谁信呢？主[雅伟]的膀臂向谁显露呢？”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，説：「主[雅偉]啊！我們所傳的有誰信呢？主[雅偉]的膀臂向誰顯露呢？」
ntBlock.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

block.zh-Hans: 我们所传的有谁信呢？雅伟的膀臂向谁显露呢？
block.zh-Hant: 我們所傳的有誰信呢？雅偉的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
block.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他们所以不能信，因为以赛亚又说：
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又説：
ntBlock.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

block.zh-Hans: 要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，便得医治。’”
block.zh-Hant: 要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，便得醫治。』」
block.en: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “主叫他们瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他们眼睛看见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「主叫他們瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他們眼睛看見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。」
ntBlock.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

block.zh-Hans: 要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，便得医治。’”
block.zh-Hant: 要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，便得醫治。』」
block.en: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 我这话不是指着你们众人说的，我知道我所拣选的是谁。现在要应验经上的话，说：‘同我吃饭的人用脚踢我。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 我這話不是指着你們眾人説的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，説：『同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。』
ntBlock.en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

block.zh-Hans: 连我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃过我饭的，也用脚踢我。
block.zh-Hant: 連我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃過我飯的，也用腳踢我。
block.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这要应验他们律法上所写的话，说：‘他们无故的恨我。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，説：『他們無故的恨我。』
ntBlock.en: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

block.zh-Hans: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的，向我夸耀；不容那无故恨我的，向我挤眼。
block.zh-Hant: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的，向我誇耀；不容那無故恨我的，向我擠眼。
block.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

block.zh-Hans: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多；无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。
block.zh-Hant: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多；無理與我為仇、要把我剪除的，甚為強盛。我沒有搶奪的，要叫我償還。
block.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 你们现在也是忧愁，但我要再见你们，你们的心就喜乐了；这喜乐也没有人能夺去。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 你們現在也是憂愁，但我要再見你們，你們的心就喜樂了；這喜樂也沒有人能奪去。
ntBlock.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

block.zh-Hans: 你们看见，就心中快乐；你们的骨头必得滋润，像嫩草一样。而且雅伟的手向他仆人所行的，必被人知道；他也要向仇敌发恼恨。
block.zh-Hant: 你們看見，就心中快樂；你們的骨頭必得滋潤，像嫩草一樣。而且雅偉的手向他僕人所行的，必被人知道；他也要向仇敵發惱恨。
block.en: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 我与他们同在的时候，因你所赐给我的名保守了他们，我也护卫了他们；其中除了那灭亡之子，没有一个灭亡的，好叫经上的话得应验。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衞了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。
ntBlock.en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

block.zh-Hans: 连我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃过我饭的，也用脚踢我。
block.zh-Hant: 連我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃過我飯的，也用腳踢我。
block.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

block.zh-Hans: 因为他们的灾难，必忽然而起。雅伟与君王所施行的毁灭，谁能知道呢？
block.zh-Hant: 因為他們的災難，必忽然而起。雅偉與君王所施行的毀滅，誰能知道呢？
block.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣一说“我就是”，他们就退后倒在地上。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌一説「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。
ntBlock.en: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

block.zh-Hans: 神对摩西说：“我是自有永有的”；又说：“你要对以色列人这样说：‘那自有的打发我到你们这里来。’”
block.zh-Hant: 神對摩西説：「我是自有永有的」；又説：「你要對以色列人這樣説：『那自有的打發我到你們這裏來。』」
block.en: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 当下彼拉多将耶稣鞭打了。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。
ntBlock.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

block.zh-Hans: 人打我的背，我任他打；人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔；人辱我，吐我，我并不掩面。
block.zh-Hant: 人打我的背，我任他打；人拔我腮頰的鬍鬚，我由他拔；人辱我，吐我，我並不掩面。
block.en: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 耶稣出来，戴着荆棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。彼拉多对他们说：“你们看这个人！”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 耶穌出來，戴着荊棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。彼拉多對他們説：「你們看這個人！」
ntBlock.en: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

block.zh-Hans: 对他说，万军之雅伟如此说：看哪！那名称为大卫苗裔的，他要在本处长起来，并要建造雅伟的殿。
block.zh-Hant: 對他説，萬軍之雅偉如此説：看哪！那名稱為大衞苗裔的，他要在本處長起來，並要建造雅偉的殿。
block.en: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他们就彼此说：“我们不要撕开，只要拈阄，看谁得着。”这要应验经上的话说：“他们分了我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。”兵丁果然做了这事。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他們就彼此説：「我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得着。」這要應驗經上的話説：「他們分了我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。」兵丁果然做了這事。
ntBlock.en: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

block.zh-Hans: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。
block.zh-Hant: 他們分我的外衣，為我的裏衣拈鬮。
block.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说：“我渴了。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就説：「我渴了。」
ntBlock.en: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

block.zh-Hans: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片；我的舌头贴在我牙床上。你将我安置在死地的尘土中。
block.zh-Hant: 我的精力枯乾，如同瓦片；我的舌頭貼在我牙牀上。你將我安置在死地的塵土中。
block.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这些事成了，为要应验经上的话说：“他的骨头一根也不可折断。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話説：「他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。」
ntBlock.en: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

block.zh-Hans: 应当在一个房子里吃；不可把一点肉从房子里带到外头去。羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。
block.zh-Hant: 應當在一個房子裏吃；不可把一點肉從房子裏帶到外頭去。羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。
block.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

block.zh-Hans: 一点不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。他们要照逾越节的一切律例而守。
block.zh-Hant: 一點不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。他們要照逾越節的一切律例而守。
block.en: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

block.zh-Hans: 又保全他一身的骨头，连一根也不折断。
block.zh-Hant: 又保全他一身的骨頭，連一根也不折斷。
block.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 经上又有一句说：“他们要仰望自己所扎的人。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 經上又有一句説：「他們要仰望自己所扎的人。」
ntBlock.en: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

block.zh-Hans: “我必将那施恩叫人恳求的灵，浇灌大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民。他们必仰望我，就是他们所扎的；必为我悲哀，如丧独生子，又为我愁苦，如丧长子。
block.zh-Hant: 「我必將那施恩叫人懇求的靈，澆灌大衞家和耶路撒冷的居民。他們必仰望我，就是他們所扎的；必為我悲哀，如喪獨生子，又為我愁苦，如喪長子。
block.en: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说：“你们受圣灵。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 説了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，説：「你們受聖靈。
ntBlock.en: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

block.zh-Hans: 以后，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。你们的儿女要说预言；你们的老年人要做异梦，少年人要见异象。在那些日子，我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女。在天上地下，我要显出奇事，有血，有火，有烟柱。日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在雅伟大而可畏的日子未到以前。到那时候，凡求告雅伟名的就必得救；因为照雅伟所说的，在锡安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有雅伟所召的。”
block.zh-Hant: 以後，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要説預言；你們的老年人要做異夢，少年人要見異象。在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女。在天上地下，我要顯出奇事，有血，有火，有煙柱。日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血，這都在雅偉大而可畏的日子未到以前。到那時候，凡求告雅偉名的就必得救；因為照雅偉所説的，在錫安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有雅偉所召的。」
block.en:
And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions: 
And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit. 
And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke. 
The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD come.

He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption. 
This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

block.en:

Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

block.en: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说：‘我要将这地赐给你的后裔。’他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉天上的主曾帶領我離開父家和本族的地，對我説話，向我起誓説：『我要將這地賜給你的後裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以從那裏為我兒子娶一個妻子。
block.en: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

block.zh-Hans: 对我说：‘我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。’
block.zh-Hant: 對我説：『我必使你生養眾多，成為多民，又要把這地賜給你的後裔，永遠為業。』
block.en: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 神说：‘他的后裔必寄居外邦，那里的人要叫他们作奴仆，苦待他们四百年。神又说：‘使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚。以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 神説：『他的後裔必寄居外邦，那裏的人要叫他們作奴僕，苦待他們四百年。神又説：『使他們作奴僕的那國，我要懲罰。以後他們要出來，在這地方事奉我。』
ntBlock.en:
And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years. 
And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟对亚伯兰说：“你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他们四百年。并且他们所要服事的那国，我要惩罚，后来他们必带着许多财物从那里出来。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉對亞伯蘭説：「你要的確知道，你的後裔必寄居別人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他們四百年。並且他們所要服事的那國，我要懲罰，後來他們必帶着許多財物從那裏出來。
block.en:
And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years; 
And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟对亚伯兰说：“你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他们四百年。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉對亞伯蘭説：「你要的確知道，你的後裔必寄居別人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他們四百年。
block.en: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 神又说：‘使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚。以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 神又説：『使他們作奴僕的那國，我要懲罰。以後他們要出來，在這地方事奉我。』
ntBlock.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

block.zh-Hans: 神说：“我必与你同在。你将百姓从埃及领出来之后，你们必在这山上事奉我；这就是我打发你去的证据。”
block.zh-Hant: 神説：「我必與你同在。你將百姓從埃及領出來之後，你們必在這山上事奉我；這就是我打發你去的證據。」
block.en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 直到有不晓得约瑟的新王兴起。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 直到有不曉得約瑟的新王興起。
ntBlock.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

block.zh-Hans: 有不认识约瑟的新王起来，治理埃及，
block.zh-Hant: 有不認識約瑟的新王起來，治理埃及，
block.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 难道你要杀我，像昨天杀那埃及人吗？’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 難道你要殺我，像昨天殺那埃及人嗎？』
ntBlock.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

block.zh-Hans: 那人说：“谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人吗？”摩西便惧怕，说：“这事必是被人知道了。”
block.zh-Hant: 那人説：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？難道你要殺我，像殺那埃及人嗎？」摩西便懼怕，説：「這事必是被人知道了。」
block.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 过了四十年，在西乃山的旷野，有一位天使从荆棘火焰中向摩西显现。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 過了四十年，在西乃山的曠野，有一位天使從荊棘火焰中向摩西顯現。
ntBlock.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟的使者从荆棘里火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，不料，荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉的使者從荊棘裏火焰中向摩西顯現。摩西觀看，不料，荊棘被火燒着，卻沒有燒毀。
block.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: ‘我是你列祖的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。’摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 『我是你列祖的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』摩西戰戰兢兢，不敢觀看。
ntBlock.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

block.zh-Hans: 又说：“我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。”摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看神。
block.zh-Hant: 又説：「我是你父親的神，是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。」摩西蒙上臉，因為怕看神。
block.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “主[雅伟]对他说：‘把你脚上的鞋脱下来；因为你所站之地是圣地。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「主[雅偉]對他説：『把你腳上的鞋脱下來；因為你所站之地是聖地。
ntBlock.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

block.zh-Hans: 神说：“不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。”
block.zh-Hant: 神説：「不要近前來。當把你腳上的鞋脱下來，因為你所站之地是聖地。」
block.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了，他们悲叹的声音，我也听见了。我下来要救他们。你来！我要差你往埃及去。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了，他們悲嘆的聲音，我也聽見了。我下來要救他們。你來！我要差你往埃及去。』
ntBlock.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

block.zh-Hans: 神说：“不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。”
block.zh-Hant: 神説：「不要近前來。當把你腳上的鞋脱下來，因為你所站之地是聖地。」
block.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟说：“我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的哀声，我也听见了。我原知道他们的痛苦，我下来是要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们出了那地，到美好、宽阔、流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉説：「我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了；他們因受督工的轄制所發的哀聲，我也聽見了。我原知道他們的痛苦，我下來是要救他們脱離埃及人的手，領他們出了那地，到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
block.en:
And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows; 
And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

block.zh-Hans: 故此我要打发你去见法老，使你可以将我的百姓以色列人从埃及领出来。”
block.zh-Hant: 故此我要打發你去見法老，使你可以將我的百姓以色列人從埃及領出來。」
block.en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “这摩西就是百姓弃绝说：‘谁立你作我们的首领和审判官’的；神却借那在荆棘中显现之使者的手差派他作首领、作救赎的。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「這摩西就是百姓棄絕説：『誰立你作我們的首領和審判官』的；神卻藉那在荊棘中顯現之使者的手差派他作首領、作救贖的。
ntBlock.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

block.zh-Hans: 那人说：“谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人吗？”摩西便惧怕，说：“这事必是被人知道了。”
block.zh-Hant: 那人説：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？難道你要殺我，像殺那埃及人嗎？」摩西便懼怕，説：「這事必是被人知道了。」
block.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: “那曾对以色列人说：‘神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我’的，就是这位摩西。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 「那曾對以色列人説：『神要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我』的，就是這位摩西。
ntBlock.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟你的神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知像我，你们要听从他。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉你的神要從你們弟兄中間給你興起一位先知像我，你們要聽從他。
block.en: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 对亚伦说：‘你且为我们造些神像，在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 對亞倫説：『你且為我們造些神像，在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
ntBlock.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

block.zh-Hans: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说：“起来！为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。”
block.zh-Hant: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他説：「起來！為我們做神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。」
block.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

block.zh-Hans: 他们对我说：‘你为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。’
block.zh-Hant: 他們對我説：『你為我們做神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
block.en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕和理番神的星，就是你们所造为要敬拜的像。因此，我要把你们迁到巴比伦外去。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 你們抬着摩洛的帳幕和理番神的星，就是你們所造為要敬拜的像。因此，我要把你們遷到巴比倫外去。』
ntBlock.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

block.zh-Hans: 以色列家啊！你们在旷野四十年，岂是将祭物和供物献给我呢？你们抬着为自己所造之摩洛的帐幕和偶像的龛，并你们的神星。所以我要把你们掳到大马色以外。这是雅伟、名为万军之神说的。”
block.zh-Hant: 以色列家啊！你們在曠野四十年，豈是將祭物和供物獻給我呢？你們抬着為自己所造之摩洛的帳幕和偶像的龕，並你們的神星。所以我要把你們擄到大馬色以外。這是雅偉、名為萬軍之神説的。」
block.en:
Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel? 
But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves. 
Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？”’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這一切不都是我手所造的嗎？」』
ntBlock.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟如此说：“天是我的座位；地是我的脚凳。你们要为我造何等的殿宇？哪里是我安息的地方呢？”雅伟说：“这一切都是我手所造的，所以就都有了。但我所看顾的，就是虚心痛悔、因我话而战兢的人。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉如此説：「天是我的座位；地是我的腳凳。你們要為我造何等的殿宇？哪裏是我安息的地方呢？」雅偉説：「這一切都是我手所造的，所以就都有了。但我所看顧的，就是虛心痛悔、因我話而戰兢的人。
block.en:
Thus saith the LORD, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest? 
For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the LORD: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他卑微的时候，人不按公义审判他；谁能述说他的世代，因为他的生命从地上夺去。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他卑微的時候，人不按公義審判他；誰能述説他的世代，因為他的生命從地上奪去。」
ntBlock.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

block.zh-Hans: 他被欺压，在受苦的时候却不开口；他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地，又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声，他也是这样不开口。因受欺压和审判，他被夺去，至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打、从活人之地被剪除，是因我百姓的罪过呢？
block.zh-Hant: 他被欺壓，在受苦的時候卻不開口；他像羊羔被牽到宰殺之地，又像羊在剪毛的人手下無聲，他也是這樣不開口。因受欺壓和審判，他被奪去，至於他同世的人，誰想他受鞭打、從活人之地被剪除，是因我百姓的罪過呢？
block.en:
He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth. 
He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 他在犹太人之地，并耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我们作见证。他们竟把他挂在木头上杀了。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 他在猶太人之地，並耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我們作見證。他們竟把他掛在木頭上殺了。
ntBlock.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

block.zh-Hans: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了雅伟你神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在神面前受咒诅的。”
block.zh-Hant: 他的屍首不可留在木頭上過夜，必要當日將他葬埋，免得玷污了雅偉你神所賜你為業之地。因為被掛的人是在神面前受咒詛的。」
block.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of God;) that thy land be not defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 既废了扫罗，就选立大卫作他们的王，又为他作见证说：‘我寻得耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 既廢了掃羅，就選立大衞作他們的王，又為他作見證説：『我尋得耶西的兒子大衞，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』
ntBlock.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

block.zh-Hans: 现在你的王位必不长久。雅伟已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守雅伟所吩咐你的。”
block.zh-Hant: 現在你的王位必不長久。雅偉已經尋着一個合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因為你沒有遵守雅偉所吩咐你的。」
block.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.

block.zh-Hans: 我寻得我的仆人大卫，用我的圣膏膏他。
block.zh-Hant: 我尋得我的僕人大衞，用我的聖膏膏他。
block.en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 既成就了经上指着他所记的一切话，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 既成就了經上指着他所記的一切話，就把他從木頭上取下來，放在墳墓裏。
ntBlock.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

block.zh-Hans: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了雅伟你神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在神面前受咒诅的。”
block.zh-Hant: 他的屍首不可留在木頭上過夜，必要當日將他葬埋，免得玷污了雅偉你神所賜你為業之地。因為被掛的人是在神面前受咒詛的。」
block.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of God;) that thy land be not defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 神已经向我们这作儿女的应验，叫耶稣复活了。正如诗篇第二篇上记着说：‘你是我的儿子，我今日生你。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 神已經向我們這作兒女的應驗，叫耶穌復活了。正如詩篇第二篇上記着説：『你是我的兒子，我今日生你。』
ntBlock.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

block.zh-Hans: 受膏者说：“我要传圣旨。雅伟曾对我说：‘你是我的儿子，我今日生你。
block.zh-Hant: 受膏者説：「我要傳聖旨。雅偉曾對我説：『你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
block.en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 论到神叫他从死里复活，不再归于朽坏，就这样说：‘我必将所应许大卫那圣洁、可靠的恩典赐给你们。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 論到神叫他從死裏復活，不再歸於朽壞，就這樣説：『我必將所應許大衞那聖潔、可靠的恩典賜給你們。』
ntBlock.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

block.zh-Hans: 你们当就近我来；侧耳而听，就必得活。我必与你们立永约，就是应许大卫那可靠的恩典。
block.zh-Hant: 你們當就近我來；側耳而聽，就必得活。我必與你們立永約，就是應許大衞那可靠的恩典。
block.en: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 又有一篇上说：‘你必不叫你的圣者见朽坏。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 又有一篇上説：『你必不叫你的聖者見朽壞。』
ntBlock.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

block.zh-Hans: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间，也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
block.zh-Hant: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
block.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: ‘主说：你们这轻慢的人要观看，要惊奇，要灭亡；因为在你们的时候，我行一件事，虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 『主説：你們這輕慢的人要觀看，要驚奇，要滅亡；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。』」
ntBlock.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

block.zh-Hans: 雅伟说：“你们要向列国中观看，大大惊奇；因为在你们的时候，我行一件事，虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。
block.zh-Hant: 雅偉説：「你們要向列國中觀看，大大驚奇；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。
block.en: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 因为主[雅伟]曾这样吩咐我们说：‘我已经立你作外邦人的光，叫你施行救恩，直到地极。’”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 因為主[雅偉]曾這樣吩咐我們説：『我已經立你作外邦人的光，叫你施行救恩，直到地極。』」
ntBlock.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

block.zh-Hans: “我雅伟凭公义召你，必搀扶你的手，保守你，使你作众民的中保，作外邦人的光，
block.zh-Hant: 「我雅偉憑公義召你，必攙扶你的手，保守你，使你作眾民的中保，作外邦人的光，
block.en: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

block.zh-Hans: 现在他说：“你作我的仆人，使雅各众支派复兴，使以色列中得保全的归回，尚为小事；我还要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。”
block.zh-Hant: 現在他説：「你作我的僕人，使雅各眾支派復興，使以色列中得保全的歸回，尚為小事；我還要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地極。」
block.en: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 正如经上所写的：‘此后，我要回来，重新修造大卫倒塌的帐幕，把那破坏的重新修造建立起来，
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 正如經上所寫的：『此後，我要回來，重新修造大衞倒塌的帳幕，把那破壞的重新修造建立起來，
ntBlock.en: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

block.zh-Hans: 到那日，我必建立大卫倒塌的帐幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破坏的建立起来，重新修造，像古时一样，
block.zh-Hant: 到那日，我必建立大衞倒塌的帳幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破壞的建立起來，重新修造，像古時一樣，
block.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 叫余剩的人，就是凡称为我名下的外邦人，都寻求主[雅伟]。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 叫餘剩的人，就是凡稱為我名下的外邦人，都尋求主[雅偉]。
ntBlock.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

block.zh-Hans: 到那日，我必建立大卫倒塌的帐幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破坏的建立起来，重新修造，像古时一样，使以色列人得以东所余剩的和所有称为我名下的国。此乃行这事的雅伟说的。”
block.zh-Hant: 到那日，我必建立大衞倒塌的帳幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破壞的建立起來，重新修造，像古時一樣，使以色列人得以東所餘剩的和所有稱為我名下的國。此乃行這事的雅偉説的。」
block.en:
In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old: 
That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 这话是从创世以来，显明这事的主[雅伟]说的。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 這話是從創世以來，顯明這事的主[雅偉]説的。』
ntBlock.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

block.zh-Hans: 你们要述说陈明你们的理，让他们彼此商议。谁从古时指明，谁从上古述说？不是我雅伟吗？除了我以外，再没有神；我是公义的神，又是救主；除了我以外，再没有别神。
block.zh-Hant: 你們要述説陳明你們的理，讓他們彼此商議。誰從古時指明，誰從上古述説？不是我雅偉嗎？除了我以外，再沒有神；我是公義的神，又是救主；除了我以外，再沒有別神。
block.en: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 保罗说：“弟兄们，我不晓得他是大祭司；经上记着说：不可毁谤你百姓的官长。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 保羅説：「弟兄們，我不曉得他是大祭司；經上記着説：不可毀謗你百姓的官長。」
ntBlock.en: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

block.zh-Hans: “不可毁谤神；也不可毁谤你百姓的官长。
block.zh-Hant: 「不可毀謗神；也不可毀謗你百姓的官長。
block.en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 因为这百姓油蒙了心，耳朵发沉，眼睛闭着；恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。’
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 因為這百姓油蒙了心，耳朵發沉，眼睛閉着；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。』
ntBlock.en: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

block.zh-Hans: 他说：“你去告诉这百姓说：‘你们听是要听见，却不明白；看是要看见，却不晓得。要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，便得医治。’”
block.zh-Hant: 他説：「你去告訴這百姓説：『你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得。要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏明白，回轉過來，便得醫治。』」
block.en:
And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not. 
Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 因为神的义正在这福音上显明出来；这义是本于信，以至于信。如经上所记：“义人必因信得生。”
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 因為神的義正在這福音上顯明出來；這義是本於信，以至於信。如經上所記：「義人必因信得生。」
ntBlock.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

block.zh-Hans: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直；惟义人因信得生。”
block.zh-Hant: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直；惟義人因信得生。」
block.en: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

ntBlock.zh-Hans: 将不能朽坏之神的荣耀变为偶像，仿佛必朽坏的人和飞禽、走兽、昆虫的样式。
ntBlock.zh-Hant: 將不能朽壞之神的榮耀變為偶像，彷彿必朽壞的人和飛禽、走獸、昆蟲的樣式。
ntBlock.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

block.zh-Hans: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。如此将他们荣耀的主，换为吃草之牛的像，
block.zh-Hant: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。如此將他們榮耀的主，換為吃草之牛的像，
block.en:
They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image. 
Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
